chapter_text_kjv.2: Ye know that after two days is the feast of the passover, and the Son of Adam is betrayed to be crucified.
chapter_text_kjv.3: Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,
chapter_text_kjv.4: And consulted that they might take Yahusha (Jesus) by subtilty, and kill him.
chapter_text_kjv.5: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar among the people.
chapter_text_kjv.6: Now when Yahusha (Jesus) was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,
chapter_text_kjv.7: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat at meat.
chapter_text_kjv.8: But when his disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose is this waste?
chapter_text_kjv.9: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.
chapter_text_kjv.10: When Yahusha (Jesus) understood it, he said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.
chapter_text_kjv.11: For ye have the poor always with you; but me ye have not always.
chapter_text_kjv.12: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body, she did it for my burial.
chapter_text_kjv.13: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, there shall also this, that this woman hath done, be told for a memorial of her.
chapter_text_kjv.14: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,
chapter_text_kjv.15: And said unto them, What will ye give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.
chapter_text_kjv.16: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
chapter_text_kjv.17: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Yahusha (Jesus), saying unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover?
chapter_text_kjv.18: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Master saith, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.
chapter_text_kjv.19: And the disciples did as Yahusha (Jesus) had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.
chapter_text_kjv.20: Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve.
chapter_text_kjv.21: And as they did eat, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
chapter_text_kjv.22: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Adonai (Lord), is it I?
chapter_text_kjv.23: And he answered and said, He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.
chapter_text_kjv.24: The Son of Adam goeth as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of Adam is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.
chapter_text_kjv.25: Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said unto him, Thou hast said.

chapter_text_kjv.29: But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father’s kingdom.
chapter_text_kjv.30: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
chapter_text_kjv.31: Then saith Yahusha (Jesus) unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.
chapter_text_kjv.32: But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.
chapter_text_kjv.33: Peter answered and said unto him, Though all men shall be offended because of thee, yet will I never be offended.
chapter_text_kjv.34: Yahusha (Jesus) said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
chapter_text_kjv.35: Peter said unto him, Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.
chapter_text_kjv.36: Then cometh Yahusha (Jesus) with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.
chapter_text_kjv.37: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.
chapter_text_kjv.38: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.
chapter_text_kjv.39: And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.
chapter_text_kjv.40: And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them asleep, and saith unto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?

chapter_text_kjv.42: He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done.
chapter_text_kjv.43: And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.
chapter_text_kjv.44: And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.
chapter_text_kjv.45: Then cometh he to his disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Adam is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
chapter_text_kjv.46: Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that doth betray me.

chapter_text_kjv.48: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast.
chapter_text_kjv.49: And forthwith he came to Yahusha (Jesus), and said, Hail, master; and kissed him.
chapter_text_kjv.50: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto him, Friend, wherefore art thou come? Then came they, and laid hands on Yahusha (Jesus), and took him.
chapter_text_kjv.51: And, behold, one of them which were with Yahusha (Jesus) stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest’s, and smote off his ear.

chapter_text_kjv.54: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?

chapter_text_kjv.66: What think ye? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.
chapter_text_kjv.67: Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote him with the palms of their hands,
chapter_text_kjv.68: Saying, Prophesy unto us, thou Messiah (Christ), Who is he that smote thee?
chapter_text_kjv.69: Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying, Thou also wast with Yahusha (Jesus) of Galilee.
chapter_text_kjv.70: But he denied before them all, saying, I know not what thou sayest.
chapter_text_kjv.71: And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with Yahusha (Jesus) of Nazareth.
chapter_text_kjv.72: And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man.

threads.summary_md: Matt 26's substantial-three-fold-disciple-architecture — (1) the substantial-Yahudah-Iscariot (Judas Iscariot)-betrayer-substance at vv.14-16, vv.20-25, and the kiss at v.49; (2) the substantial-Gethsemane-watching-substance at vv.36-46 (the disciples falling asleep + the King's *watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak*); (3) the substantial-Kefa (Peter)-three-fold-denial-substance at vv.69-75 + the substantial-bitter-weeping at v.75 — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of (a) the friend-become-enemy + the sinner-with-the-double-tongue substance, (b) the prepare-the-soul-for-temptation + the gold-tried-in-the-fire substance, and (c) the enemy-speaking-sweetly-with-the-lips-while-imagining-the-pit substance the substantial Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) carries-substantively. Five moves: Sirach 6:1 names the substantial-friend-become-enemy + sinner-with-the-double-tongue substance (the substantial-Yahudah-Iscariot (Judas Iscariot)'s *Master, is it I?* at v.25 walks-substantively-the-double-tongue-substance the wisdom-stream had named-the-substance-for); Sirach 12:16 names the substantial-enemy-who-speaks-sweetly-with-the-lips-while-imagining-the-pit substance (the substantial-Yahudah-Iscariot (Judas Iscariot)'s kiss at v.49 walks-substantively in continuity with Proverbs 27:6's *the kisses of an enemy are deceitful* + Psalm 55:12-14's *for it was not an enemy that reproached me ... but it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance*); Sirach 37:2 names the substantial-grief-to-death-when-a-companion-and-friend-is-turned-to-an-enemy substance (the King's *Friend, wherefore art thou come?* at v.50 + the King's *my soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death* at v.38 — the substantial-Suffering-Servant-grief-substance Isaiah 53:3 walks-into); Sirach 2:1 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the prepare-your-soul-for-temptation substance (the King's *watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation* at v.41 walks-substantively the substantial-pre-Christian-Tanakh-wisdom-stream-substance the prophet-David walked at Psalm 51:5 + 103:14 walks-into); Sirach 2:5 names the substantial-gold-tried-in-the-fire + the acceptable-men-in-the-furnace-of-adversity substance (the substantial-Kefa (Peter)-three-fold-denial-substance + the bitter-weeping at v.75 walks-substantively-the-substantial-furnace-of-adversity-substance + the substantial-rending-of-the-heart-into-restoration-substance the substantial Psalm 51:17 + Joel 2:12-13 + John 21:15-19 walks-into). The framework reads the cluster carefully — the substantial-Kefa (Peter)-substance walks-the-disciple-falling-into-the-pattern-of-the-faithless-generation-substance per the substantial 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 7:48 substance the S154 thread 4 anchor walked (*O thou Adam, what hast thou done? ... the fall was not thine alone, but ours also that come of thee*); the substantial *and he went out, and wept bitterly* substance walks the substantial-disciple's-repentance-tear-substance that breaks-the-generational-pattern by the substantial-kingdom-grace through-the-substantial-Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit)-internalized-Torah-on-the-new-heart substance Ezekiel 36:26-27 walks-into directly. The substantial-direct-rule-out of the categorical-Reformation-eternal-security-substance — Kefa (Peter) has-failed + walks-the-bitter-weeping + walks-the-restoration through-the-walking-the-repentance-substance, NOT-categorically-once-saved-always-saved (Red Line #2 + the framework-deep's *Grace, the Way, the New Heart, and the Mercy of Depart* section). System-not-people posture holds non-negotiable — the substance walks-against the substantial-betrayer-architecture and the substantial-faithless-flesh-weakness-substance, NEVER against the substantial-disciples-as-people; the substantial-disciples-substance are the substantial-citizens-of-the-substantial-kingdom-substance walking-substantively-into-the-substantial-restoration-substance through-the-substantial-bitter-weeping-substance the King walks-out at-the-substantial-substance.

members_in_this_chapter.member_note: Ecclesiasticus 6:1 — *Instead of a friend become not an enemy.* Judas's *Master, is it I?* at Matthew 26:25 with the bargain already made.

Ecclesiasticus 12:16 — *An enemy speaks sweetly with his lips, but in his heart he imagineth how to throw you into a pit.* The enemy with sweet lips is Judas with Hail, master, and a kiss at Matthew 26:49.
Ecclesiasticus 37:2 — *when a companion and friend is turned to an enemy.* *Friend, wherefore art thou come?* (Matthew 26:50) is this grief spoken in the garden.
Ecclesiasticus 2:1 — *My son, if you come to serve Yahuah (God), prepare your soul for temptation.* The watch and pray the sleeping disciples did not keep at Matthew 26:41.

threads.title: The Elect One vindicated on the throne and the kings and the mighty condemned — 1 Enoch 46, 48, 62 and 63 beside Matthew 26:64
threads.summary_md: Bound and under oath before the high priest, Yahusha (Jesus) answers with the two verses the Sanhedrin knew best: *Yahusha (Jesus) saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.* (Matthew 26:64). Sitting at the right hand is David's psalm; coming in the clouds is Daniel's night vision: *I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.* (Daniel 7:13). Daniel says the figure was like a son of Adam, because the one he saw was going to take on flesh; the man in front of Caiaphas is the one Daniel's figure resembled, and he says so with the title and no comparison. Enoch had seen him by name beside the Head of Days: *And I asked the angel who went with me and showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?* (1 Enoch 46:2), and he had been told what this Son of Adam would do to men who sit in judgement seats: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.* (1 Enoch 46:4). He was named before anything they ruled over was made: *Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 48:3). So the court that condemned him that night will one day stand in his: *And all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth Shall fall down before him on their faces, And worship and set their hope upon that Son of Adam, And petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.* (1 Enoch 62:9). Enoch even records what they will say when it is too late: *And splendid in every secret thing is Thy power from generation to generation, And Thy glory for ever and ever: Deep are all Thy secrets and innumerable, And Thy righteousness is beyond reckoning.* (1 Enoch 63:3). Isaiah swore the same oath for the Father, *That unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.* (Isaiah 45:23), and Paul puts it on the name of Yahusha: *That at the name of Yahusha (Jesus) every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;* (Philippians 2:10). The ones who will bow are the kings and the mighty, the leadership that persecuted the houses of his congregations, not the Yahudim (Jews) as a people. The King on trial is of the tribe of Yahudah (Judah) himself, and so are the men who followed him out of that courtyard.

members_in_this_chapter.member_note: *And I asked the angel who went with me and showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?* (1 Enoch 46:2). *Hereafter shall ye see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven* (Matthew 26:64). The bound man before the council names himself with Enoch's title — *that Son of Adam* who went with the Head of Days. The council thought it was judging him; he was telling them who would judge.
1 Enoch 46:4 — *Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats.* The council that sentenced him (Matthew 26:64) will be raised from its seats by him.
1 Enoch 48:3 — *His name was named before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* The Father named the Son before the world; the Sanhedrin's verdict (Matthew 26:64–66) does not.

*And all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth Shall fall down before him on their faces, And worship and set their hope upon that Son of Adam, And petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.* (1 Enoch 62:9). *Hereafter shall ye see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power* (Matthew 26:64). Enoch saw what the council will see: all the kings and the mighty falling on their faces before that Son of Adam, petitioning him for mercy. The men who condemned him will kneel to him.
